en.title: Get Sizes of Friends Groups
en.description:
Initially, each person is in a single-person group. F a b merges the groups of the two people; T a b adds the sizes of the two people's groups to a running total. If the two people are already in the same group, the group size is taken separately for each of the two people as the statement says, so it is counted twice. Output the total over all T operations.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and do not mean that the original problem provides these limits.
en.input: n q≤100000, followed by q lines, each with F/T and two ID values in 1..n.
en.output: Output the accumulated value, using a 64-bit integer.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
